title: Nomic Structure and Reduction
summary: The canonical formulation of physical theories with irregular nomic structure is as constrained Hamiltonian theories within which ill-posedness of the equations of motion is connected to a pernicious form of surplus representational capacity. Such theories can be converted into theories with regular nomic structure and a well-posed initial value problem via the process of symplectic reduction.
